addins.name: Notes Word Count
addins.author: formdeck
addins.description: A task pane that counts the words in your speaker notes and estimates your talk time, slide by slide.

addins.name: Replace Fonts
addins.author: formdeck
addins.description: Lists the fonts used across your deck and swaps one for another everywhere in a single undoable step.
